info.title: sFlow
info.description: RESTful interface for AOS-CX switch software

agent_address.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address used in sFlow datagrams to identify the device that sent the sFlow data to the sFlow collector. It is usually set to an IP address on  the device that is reachable from the collector. This field is mandatory for  sFlow to be enabled.If not configured,sFlow will not be programmed and sFlow datagrams will not be transmitted.

collectors.description:
Reference Resource: [sFlow_collector](#/sFlow_collector)
sFlow collectors that should receive the samples.

enabled.description: Enables sFlow globally in the system

header.description: Number of bytes of a sampled packet to send to the collector.

max_datagram.description: Maximum number of bytes that will be send in the sFlow datagram.

name.description:
Reference Resource: [sFlow](#/sFlow)
sFlow identifier for the configuration. Should be alphanumeric.

num_clear_stats_performed.description: Number of clear sFlow statistics performed.

num_clear_stats_requested.description: Number of clear sFlow statistics requested.

polling.description: Specifies the interval in seconds at which counter statistics are sent to the  collector.

reachability_check.description: The device periodically probes all configured collectors using ICMP echo. When reachability_check is enabled,the device will send SFLOW datagrams only to those collectors which respond to ICMP request.When not enabled, it will disregard the ICMP echo check outcome and will send SFLOW datagrams to the configured collectors.

sampling.description: Specifies the rate at which packets should be sampled and sent to the collector.

statistics.description: Key value pairs that has sampling statistics.

num_sampled_pkts.description: Total number of sampled packets sent to the collector.

parameters.name: selector
parameters.description: Select configuration, status and/or statistics. Default is all categories.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filter rows by attribute values.  Format: attribute:value

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Count the number of rows found.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: Entity-tag value for representation comparison (see RFC 7232 - Conditional Requests - section 3.2)
